```cardsmith
card:
  system: daggerheart
  card-type: ancestry
  language: en
data:
  # The card's name, shown as the title on the front. Falls back to the note's file name when unset.
  name: Dwarf

  # The card's text — Markdown; a feature's name in bold, as the cards print it.
  description: |-
    **Thick Skin:** When you take Minor damage, you can mark 2 Stress instead of marking a Hit Point.
  
    **Increased Fortitude:** Spend 3 Hope to halve incoming physical damage.

  # A picture for the upper half of the front — a wikilink to an image in the vault. Without one the text moves up.
  image: # no sample

  # Empty boxes to tick off with a pen. A number (`20`), a labelled row (`{ count: 20, label: Arrows }`) or a list of such rows. `group` (default 5) sets how many boxes stand together.
  tracker: # no sample

  # One line on the ancestry, in italics under the name.
  blurb: Short humanoids with square frames, dense musculature and thick hair.
```
